caseName: Superintendent, Massachusetts Correctional Institution v. Hill

opinions.text: Sup. Jud. Ct. Mass. [Certiorari granted, ante, p. 1016.] Motion for appointment of counsel granted, and it is ordered that Jamie Ann Sabino, *1085of Wellesley, Mass., be appointed to serve as counsel for respondents in this case.
